task.description: Implement XC cross-cutting requirements per design doc (src/design/xc-requirements.md). Implementation scope: (1) XC-01 trace propagation—thread-local trace context in request handler, UUID generation, propagation to logging/audit/scheduler, response headers; (2) XC-02 audit immutability—schema migration (chain_hash, prev_chain_hash columns), cryptographic chaining logic per ADP-09; (3) XC-03 configuration in repository—src/config loader module, artifact registration, atomic activation; (4) XC-04 kernel determinism—grep validation that event store/transition/scheduler have no LLM calls, document constraint; (5) XC-05 deterministic replay—extend state reconstruction to use pointInTime and validate determinism; (6) XC-06 backwards compatibility—define instance/definition migration paths, ensure additive-only schema changes. All schema migrations via numbered SQL files under migrations/. Run zig build; zig build test; zig build migrate.

result.summary: Implemented all six cross-cutting requirements (XC-01 through XC-06) per design specification. XC-01 (trace propagation) verified in existing middleware and extended audit table. XC-02 (audit immutability) implemented with SHA-256 chain hash functions. XC-03 (config in repository) created loader module. XC-04 (kernel determinism) validated via grep (zero LLM calls) and documented in all kernel modules. XC-05 (deterministic replay) extended state reconstruction with pointInTime support. XC-06 (backwards compatibility) ensured all migrations are additive-only.
